basic_info.description: Central Sunset center patio home conveniently located just half block to MUNI lines, 1.5 blocks to Golden Gate Park, and just several short blocks to Irving Street shops & restaurants. This home features living room, formal dining room, breakfast area, center patio, kitchen in its original charm, split bath, and two bedrooms side by side in the back. Interior stairway leads to additional unwarranted family room and bath on the ground floor with a large garage for 2 car tandem parking. There is a separate side door from the street to access the lower floor. Low maintenance yard!
